commits.edited_message:
Limit AI7 thumbnail expansion

Bound the decoded RGB allocation and reject encoded data that is too large relative to the declared output size.

Improve performance of decodeAi7Thumbnail.

Use a preallocated buffer for decoded pixels and avoid rechecking each run; the encoded-size check in getData() already bounds expansion.

coupling: The first edited commit adds an encoded-size preflight that permits one encoded byte per 128 bytes of declared RGB output. On its own, that commit remains safe because the decoder still has an append-time bound. The second edited commit switches to a fixed-size DataBuf and removes that append-time bound as redundant under the new preflight. AI7 RLE escapes are three encoded bytes and can expand to 765 output bytes (a 255x ratio), so the preflight underestimates expansion. The probe declares 1024x1 (3072 bytes), supplies 24 encoded image bytes, and uses seven 255-pixel runs; the preflight accepts 24 <= 3072/128, after which the unchecked writer emits 5355 bytes. A correct repair must reconcile the preflight expansion factor with the decoder write contract rather than treating the two commits as independent maintenance changes.
